notes: Release date printed on page: 2025-10-27 (also free-trial extension to November 7th 00:00 UTC corroborates late-Oct timing). Old URL minimax.io/blog/minimax-m2 now 404s; live slug is minimax-m2-en-1748600000 (the numeric suffix is not the release timestamp - page date is authoritative). Page is Next.js JS-rendered: web reader returned only the site shell, so a headless-browser DOM scan was required (same degradation path as GLM-5.3-Flash and MiniMax M3). Prose contains no absolute benchmark scores; all agentic/coding/search values render inside one 8676x3593 comparison image -> rows pending with vision-assisted reads in notes only (goal.md 12.5). The single verified row is the Artificial Analysis top-five rank claim (third_party_reported, excluded from vendor self-report counts). Unlike the M3 post, this page has no Evaluation Methodology section - harness/sampling protocol undisclosed; recommended serving params (temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20) are deployment guidance, not eval protocol, hence recorded null. Comparison columns in the big image: MiniMax-M2, DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.6, Kimi K2 0905, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5 (thinking). Two price/speed scatter charts and a 1-on-1 practical-performance comparison image were not transcribed (no benchmark row names). Positioning: 8% of Claude Sonnet price, ~2x speed; weights open-sourced on HuggingFace.
